purpose: Regression guard only; the LLM panel does not decide elegance or prove non-inferiority.
discarded_pre_final_pilot: All responses to superseded v8 drafts, including SHAs 50d236b2, 8222e96b, ee0c338e, 4567041a, 3a9ef852, and 093d4bc8, plus developmental micro-edits, are excluded as final-v8.1 evidence.
allocation: Four fresh single-version readers for final v8.1; compare them with the already-blind four-reader v6 anchor in abstract_v8_g62_raw.json. No v8.1 reader sees another abstract, project context, title, TL;DR, target rubric, or comparison prompt.
prompt: Read the abstract once. Without rereading or comparing it to anything else: (1) retell its core scientific finding and implication in no more than 30 English words; (2) rate clarity 1–5; (3) rate memorability 1–5; (4) rate willingness to bid as a reviewer 1–5; (5) quote or name the first confusing phrase, or 'none'; (6) state any scientific overclaim invited and label it none, minor, or major.
no_observed_regression_rule: count(v8.1 major overread) <= count(v6 major overread)
fewer than two v8.1 readers independently report the same new parsing failure absent from v6
reporting: Report raw counts and medians only; do not call the result statistical equivalence or non-inferiority.
